decisions.reason: The net price display plugin still fits the firm's shop implementation work, but its low differentiation and absence from later website observations raise a meaningful risk that it could be folded into standard service delivery rather than kept as a standalone product.

The ERP system interface plugin remains strategically important because it supports end-to-end shop operations, multichannel integration and client retention, so management would usually keep it despite some portfolio-cleanup risk.

After already removing similar price comparison tracking plugins and with the firm moving toward broader multichannel and mobile commerce support, this remaining tracking plugin is the most likely candidate to be discontinued in favor of core services and newer development.

The net price reporting plugin still complements the firm's analytics and optimization positioning, although modest standalone visibility suggests some risk of consolidation into broader reporting offerings rather than formal continuation as a separate product.
